content_metadata.description: A detailed instructional video on duck diving techniques for surfing, followed by a brief preview of a turtle roll lesson.

qAndA.answer: The instructor advises using the shin to push down on smaller surfboards.
qAndA.question: What does the instructor suggest a surfer use to push down on a small surfboard during a duck dive?

qAndA.answer: The instructor emphasizes keeping your eyes open to anticipate and navigate the turbulent and airy patches of whitewash.
qAndA.question: Why does the instructor recommend keeping your eyes open during a duck dive?

qAndA.answer: The large volume of the board makes it buoyant and harder to push underwater, requiring more force.
qAndA.question: What makes duck diving a larger surfboard more challenging?

qAndA.answer: The instructor demonstrates tilting the board before pushing down, allowing it to scoop through the wave more easily.
qAndA.question: What alternative does the instructor suggest for duck diving a large surfboard?

youtube_description:
Holly Beck, pro surfer and coach at Surf With Amigas explains how to do a duck dive and analyzes footage of Amigas trying it so you can see what they're doing wrong and how to fix it. 
If you like the coaching, join us on a womens surf and yoga retreat. Check out the website for details!
http://www.surfwithamigas.com
